title: MTBF ladder (book)
caption: The book's two-bar log-scale comparison of one GPU's 50,000-hour MTTF against a 25,000-GPU job's ~2-hour MTBF. Ours adds the measured Llama 3 point so the arithmetic meets the production record on the same line.

title: CI knee (book)
caption: Communication intensity against fleet size showing where a job crosses fabric balance. Ours derives the same mechanism as arithmetic inside the step anatomy (96→12 sequences per replica) rather than a knee plot.

title: Fleet-law step decomposition (book)
caption: The book's breakdown of a synchronous step into its compute, communication and coordination spans. Ours uses the measured 1,024-GPU numbers as a single anatomy bar keyed to the fleet-law equation.

title: C³ taxonomy (book)
caption: The book's three-dimension C³ landscape figure. Ours keeps the narrower projection map — D·A·M nouns to C³ verbs — which is what the reader uses to triage an optimization.

title: Fleet stack bands (book)
caption: The four coupled bands — Infrastructure, Distribution, Serving, Governance — as the book draws them. Left to the book's figure; our packet keeps the coupling warning in prose.

title: The scale discontinuity (book)
caption: Single-machine memory wall versus the fleet's network-plus-coordination wall. Our scale-climb figure makes the same point quantitatively — the ~4-order fleet ladder against the ~7-order compute ladder.
